correctness.rationale: For oriented edges of Q_d and D incidence, projector Π=D(D^T D)^+D^T, heat-kernel representation ∫D H_t D^Tdt yields same-coordinate nonnegative row mass 1 and different-coordinate absolute row mass 1/2; thus intact norm (d+1)/2. Removing nonbridge h gives exact rank-one projector update Π'(f,g)=Π(f,g)+Π(f,h)Π(h,g)/(1-Π(h,h)); denominator >0 because cube remains connected. For parallel edge e one transverse Hamming step away, heat-integral identities give q_d=(2^d-1)/(d 2^(d-1)), a_d=(2^d-d-1)/(d(d-1)2^(d-1)), α=a_d/(1-q_d)>0; sign pattern makes damaged row masses 1 own-direction, (1-α)/2 in one transverse direction and (1+α)/2 in d-2 remaining directions. Summation proves R_d=(d+1)/2+(d-3)α/2 for all d>=2, > intact for every d>=4, and d(R_d-(d+1)/2)→1. Independently built exact rational Walsh eigencharacter projection and all deleted row sums in d=2,3,4, obtaining entire histograms d2: norm1 all3 rows, d3: max2 and counts 2×2,9/5×1,15/8×4,39/20×4; d4: max133/51, norming exactly 3 edges at transverse Hamming distance one; other row sums 125/51×3,41/17×1,22/9×6,42/17×12,127/51×6. Each row signed vector reaches row norm. Global sharp norm for d>=5 is expressly unclaimed; analytic row bound rather than finite extrapolation proves all d>=4.
